key_insight: PAIR-IBD spatially quantified inflammation and crypt injury to distinguish pathologist-defined active ulcerative colitis from histological remission; this study is not about cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: The system could complement pathology scoring and support histological endpoint assessment in ulcerative colitis trials, pending validation.
method: Trained a deep-learning ensemble on three IBD datasets.
Identified inflammatory cells and segmented mucosal compartments.
Quantified compartment-specific cell densities, epithelial damage and crypt architecture.
evidence_signal: In a single clinical network, active biopsies had 5.3-fold higher crypt neutrophil density than Nancy-defined remission, while key AI metrics correlated with manual scores (Spearman rs=0.50–0.73).
watch_item: Single-network evaluation limits generalizability; remission-like individual metrics in inconclusive biopsies do not establish a remission diagnosis.
paper_title: Spatial AI quantification of inflammatory and architectural features differentiates pathologist-defined active ulcerative colitis from histological remission
